title: Session-superseded event (server -> agent, outbound)
description: Emitted to the OLD socket when a new authenticated connection presents the same passport (client_id). One-live-session-per-passport (agent-passports.md §4). Immediately followed by a WSS close with code 4409. This is what makes credential resale self-defeating: two users sharing one passport keep kicking each other off. If the old session had a live match binding, that binding transfers to the new session (reconnect semantics).

superseded_by.description: The new session that took the slot.

reason.const: another connection authenticated with this passport
